text: 2026年10月9日下午，财政部副部长廖岷在北京会见高盛集团总裁兼首席运营官温泽恩，双方就中美经贸关系和中美宏观经济形势等议题交换意见。
text_en: On the afternoon of October 9, 2026, Vice Minister of Finance Liao Min met in Beijing with John Waldron, President and Chief Operating Officer of Goldman Sachs Group, and the two sides exchanged views on topics including China-US economic and trade relations and the macroeconomic situations of China and the United States.
